context.problem_statement: Using the provided dataset, perform a factorial ANOVA to determine if there is a significant interaction effect between 'species' and 'sepal_width' on 'petal_size'. After performing the ANOVA, conduct a post-hoc test to identify which groups differ significantly. Report the p-value for the interaction term and the results of the post-hoc test.
context.expert_knowledge: Factorial ANOVA is used to evaluate the influence of two or more categorical independent variables on a continuous dependent variable. Interaction effects examine how factors interact with each other in their effect on the dependent variable. Post-hoc tests are applied to determine which specific group means are different after finding a significant F-statistic in ANOVA.
